proposal_text: Gate-loop recurrence, third phase in a row (Phase 15 overrides, Phase 16 overrides 1f15661a/f0b67f91, Phase 17 VETOs at META_LEDGER #96, #98, #100 in session 2026-10-10T0443-9d3df3). The Phase 16 remediation (closure_enforcer '/qor-audit Step 3') did not prevent recurrence. Root cause across all three Phase 17 VETOs: the plan asserted empirical facts (cited line numbers, list counts, function and file sizes, enum literals, absence of import cycles, and red-first versus regression-lock test status) that the Governor never executed against the named refs, so each audit found a new unexecuted claim (V4/V5/V6/V9, N1/N3/N4, F1/F3/F4/F5). Process change: (1) a plan for phase 17 or later must carry exactly one ```json qor-plan-claims manifest that restates every such empirical claim as an executable claim (git-grep, function-lines, file-lines, or a command expected to pass or fail at an exact ref); (2) before submitting to /qor-audit the Governor must run `python -m pytest tests/test_plan_claims_manifest.py` green at the plan commit and record the run in the PLAN ledger entry; (3) the Judge runs the same command at /qor-audit Step 0.6 and treats a failure as a not-ready short-circuit (no cycle consumed); an empirical claim in plan prose without a manifest entry is a specification-drift finding. Not code: no application source changes. Phase 17 has no process-shadow events of its own: cycle_count_escalator.check returned None (the three VETO signatures differ) and check_session_total raised UnmappedCategoryError (Qor-logic-plus #173), so no escalation event was written; none is manufactured here.

proposed_changes.change: New executable plan-claims gate: rejects a phase>=17 plan with no qor-plan-claims manifest and executes git-grep, function-lines, file-lines and command (pass/fail at exact ref) claims.
proposed_changes.rationale: Turns every empirical plan claim into a reproducible check; self-tests cover drift, oversize, misclassified red-first, duplicate ids and grandfathering.

proposed_changes.change: Every cited line, count, size, enum literal, absent import and red-first/regression-lock status appears in the qor-plan-claims manifest; the manifest passes at the plan commit before the PLAN ledger entry is written.
proposed_changes.rationale: V4-V6, V9, N1, N3, F1, F3, F4, F5 were all unexecuted claims.

proposed_changes.change: Judge runs `python -m pytest tests/test_plan_claims_manifest.py`; failure is a not-ready short-circuit; a prose empirical claim lacking a manifest entry is specification-drift.
proposed_changes.rationale: Moves mechanical verification ahead of adversarial review so audit cycles are spent on judgment, not on re-executing greps.

proposed_changes.target: Phase 17 next authorized plan iteration (inputs, not edits made here)
proposed_changes.change: Reconcile F1 (51-zone test is regression-lock: command claim expect pass), F2 (golden duplicates at positions 0 and 1, plus command claims proving cap-before-dedupe and reorder mutations fail), F3 (keep himalayasQuery with HIMALAYAS_SEARCH_ENDPOINT; git-grep expect_absent for the reverse import), F4 (split or explicitly exempt registerCoreIpcHandlers; function-lines claim), F5 (runtimeKind 'electron'; git-grep on src/shared/runtime.ts).
proposed_changes.rationale: Iteration-4 findings expressed as executable claims.

proposed_changes.rationale: Explains why no Phase 17 escalation event exists.
